supports: ind_dat is written directly as the independent detections CSV
ind_dat uses literal placename and timestamp to restrict detections to active camera days
ind_dat uses literal sp as the species field
independent events are grouped by deployment_id and sp
ind_dat is one row per independent event after duplicate event_id removal
ind_dat$sp is explicitly converted to factor before export
ind_dat is exported without a select/rename step
caribou is selected by literal token Rangifer.tarandus from field sp
common name caribou maps to sp token Rangifer.tarandus
raw detections were aggregated into independent detections using a 30-minute same-species same-station rule
model response was station_time by species independent-detection counts
six-month seasons were summer April-September and winter October-March
station-time periods below 30 camera-days were excluded in the original published analysis
paper_semantics.note: paper semantics support the interpretation of the public generation code but do not supply exact CSV header names

frozen_response_parser.additional_columns_policy: allowed_but_ignored_unless separately frozen before response access

node_join.normalization: exact string after outer whitespace strip only
node_join.unmatched_response_nodes: outside locked candidate universe and ignored

time_join.justification: public generation code builds active-day lookup with seq(start_date,end_date,by='days') and filters independent detections by date-prefix plus placename

taxon_match.token_normalization: outer whitespace strip only; case-sensitive exact match
taxon_match.response_taxonomic_resolution: species token Rangifer.tarandus; response table is not claimed to encode subspecies

event_semantics.positive_rule: eligible node-context is positive iff at least one exact Rangifer.tarandus independent-event row maps to it
event_semantics.negative_rule: eligible node-context with zero mapped exact Rangifer.tarandus events is a recorded non-detection under complete-source-zero
event_semantics.initialization_rule: phase1 response is used only for pre-phase2 source initialization and is never scored
